The jade panel is drawn blind, the pulse escrow settles at close, and opal lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 24% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 274 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
